{{Quote|Since it serves our purposes we've done nothing to counter the belief that we are perversions of the Jedi, evil mages, embodiments of hatred, rage, and bloodlust, capable even of leaving the residue of our malefactions and dastardly deeds in places of power.''"<br />"''Why have we not yet visited those places, Master&mdash;instead of worlds like Buoyant and Hypori?|Darth Plagueis and Darth Sidious|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
'''Buoyant''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] by a [[Unidentified Bouyant species|sentient species]] [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]]. The alterations made to Buoyant by the terraformers included an increased rotation rate as well as lush [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]] and imported [[Species/Legends|animals]], among them a [[Unidentified quadruped|long-necked herd quadruped]].

In 54 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], Buoyant was visited by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. The two engaged in a series of [[Hunting/Legends|hunts]] in various biomes of the planet, [[Death/Legends|killing]] numerous creatures in order to strengthen their connection to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and also discussing the nature of the dark side.

==Description==
{{Quote|We serve nature's purpose by culling the herd, and our own by sharpening our skills.|Darth Plagueis|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
Buoyant was a low-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Buoyant system/Legends|same name]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point, a [[Unidentified Bouyant species|sentient species]] had [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] the planet, increasing its rotation rate so that [[Standard day/Legends|days]] and nights alternated rapidly. Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] also altered the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and, by [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]], it was being regularly scrubbed by violent, fast-moving storms.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

On Buoyant's surface, the terraformers encouraged the expansion of wide-ranging [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]] and dense [[Forest/Legends|forests]] as part of an experiment. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] after the modifications to Buoyant's ecosystem, the planet also featured [[Savanna/Legends|savannas]], arid [[Desert/Legends|wastes]], and inland [[Ocean/Legends|seas]]. By 54 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the planet's [[Plant/Legends|flora]] was represented by brushes growing in the savannas as well as a species of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that had thick branches, an enormous canopy, and a trunk wide enough to contain a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] inside. [[Flower/Legends|Flowering]] [[Parasite/Legends|parasitic]] plants grew on at least one of the trees' branches.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

When experimenting with Buoyant, the terraformers also imported several animal species, which were numerous and well adapted by 54 BBY, resulting in a bewildering mix of plants and animals on the planet. All of Buoyant's fauna was quick-moving and included flying [[Insect/Legends|insects]] as well as long-necked herd [[Unidentified quadruped|quadrupeds]] with [[Color/Legends|brown]]-and-black-striped [[Hair/Legends|fur]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==History==
{{Quote|This is not a chase, this is a summoning.|Darth Plagueis|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
[[File:PlagueisCover.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Buoyant was visited by Darth Plagueis and his apprentice, Darth Sidious.]]
Millennia before 54 BBY, a sentient species terraformed an<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Inner Rim<ref name="TERC" /> planet, altering its ecosystem and introducing several animal species from offworld. The sentients had been long-forgotten by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 54 BBY, during which [[Time/Legends|time]] the planet had become known as Buoyant and was visited by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. The pair engaged in a series of [[Hunting/Legends|hunts]] there, [[Death/Legends|killing]] many creatures in Buoyant's forests, wastes, and under several of the planet's seas, all in order to strengthen their own connection to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

The two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], armed with [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]] and traveling on [[Limb/Legends|foot]], also hunted members of a local quadruped species for several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] across the grasslands of Buoyant. After the extensive and tiresome hunt, Plagueis and Sidious rested beneath one of the planet's large trees, engaging in a discussion on the differences between the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and dark sides of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. To illustrate a point he was making during the conversation, Sidious's [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] ignited the nearby grass in the savanna with a display of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], causing a brief brush [[Fire/Legends|fire]]. Later, when Plagueis had Sidious undergo combat [[Sith training|training]] on the planet [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]], the latter expressed his impatience with visiting Buoyant and Hypori instead of worlds like [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], and [[Zigoola]], which had a strong connection to the dark side as well as historical significance to the Sith.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Locations==
By 54 BBY, Buoyant's landscape was dotted by machines used by the sentient species that had terraformed the planet. Despite the species being long-forgotten, the equipment left behind on Buoyant was still functioning by that time.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Buoyant first appeared in [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], a [[2012]] novel written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> The 2012 reference book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' placed Buoyant in grid square J-14.<ref name="TERC" />
